html:
Teeth Cleaning

Bi-Annual Teeth Cleanings in Kansas City, MO

Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport maintains optimal oral health and beauty with our routine teeth cleanings in Kansas City, MO. As recommended by the American Dental Association, we encourage our patients to schedule dental cleanings and exams at least once every six months. Regular cleanings reduce the amount of plaque and tartar buildup within hard-to-reach areas in the mouth. They also allow your dentist to examine your teeth and gums and look for signs of disease or decay. We provide preventative care and treatments to protect our patients' oral health and address concerns quickly and carefully. You can expect convenient, comfortable care from our team.
Contact Us

In-Depth Dental Care for Individuals and Families

The best way to take care of your mouth is by brushing and flossing daily. However, there are hidden cracks and crevices within the mouth where plaque and tartar hide. These spaces are often tricky for at-home brushes and floss to reach. That's why getting your teeth cleaned by a dentist or hygienist at least twice a year is important. We use the latest technology and treatments to maintain and enhance oral health. You'll receive the following during your six-month checkup:

  • Thorough dental cleanings.
  • Plaque and bacteria removal.
  • Comprehensive exams and checkups.
  • A friendly staff and an accommodating office.

Are You Due for a Checkup?

Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport is proud to fulfill the dental and oral health needs of new and returning patients. Whether you want to change your dentist or you've been visiting us for years, we're committed to your smile. Our flexible financing and wide range of insurance acceptances make it easy for patients to receive affordable, quality dental care. We encourage you to schedule your next cleaning and exam if your last was six or more months ago. We'll carefully assess your oral health condition and compare it to the results of your last visit. We look forward to making your smile the best it can be.

Choose Us for the Perfect Smile

Call Now
